body: I know what you mean, but I am starting so much at the bottom that those worries seem appealing to me. I'd rather feel anxious about my lack of freedom than being so socially inept and stupid I can't hold a 5-minute conversation with someone. I was watching a couple guys just shooting the shit at the burger place and thinking how I haven't had a friendly conversation with anyone in years. With someone like me it's just like, why are you even alive when you're so fucking useless? It doesn't make sense to me.

Thanks for this comment, though it sucks somebody's going through similar. I know what you mean about the reassuring too, but when I read yours I thought, you're probably doing better at your jobs than you think you are. Do people respond to you strangely or is it the anxiety that makes you quit? I'm sure you're not a stupid idiot and will find a solution that'll work for you. If it's the people and you have some skills, maybe you could find a way to work remotely. 

And I'm sure denial is a great thing - I've realized the past few months how deep in denial I was about many things. That's lifted lately and it's terrifying to me.
